extraction.Name: Winnie Larvie Bull Tail
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I could not pay the tax and so I sold it
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered in 1920 from the farmer at Black Pipe; did not ask for the patent and did not want it; sold land for $2500.00 — $1158 in cash, then later got the other $1200.00; sale was satisfactory; purchaser gave all he agreed to; did not sign the receipt for the patent; has five children; in good health; signed with mark (Qruule Koui); notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32
